evidence: The draft registration specifies intervention, controls, a two-sided falsifier, metrics, leakage checks and statistics, and traces the seven combined-read requirements, the verifier's three caveats, D48's four items and D52's five (registration sections 'Repair under D48' and 'Repair under D52'). D52: GO's spill guard is a pooled pre-literal statistic evaluable for 0.53 to 0.67 of development families (the per-family rule: 0.20 to 0.22, E16, real tokenizer, proxy stop lists); GO needs both directions with lower bounds above 0, a direction floor and a log-retention co-statistic, so multiplicative and floor-saturating nulls cannot reach it; the literal-free sensitivity is gated at the pre-step (item 9) and bounded model-free (kappa LF 0.74 to 0.77, PRE 1.15 to 1.17); simulation S3 (E17) uses measured inputs (67 clusters, per-family evidence sizes, LF and PRE as statistics) and puts every constructed false GO at most 0.01 (0.12 for a real sub-threshold excess on spill), false kills at most 0.09 except a layer-3-only failure (0.26). Not met: the decision-62 simulation with the v3 code cannot exist before the code; masked, literal-free and pre-literal headroom and kappa on real data are unmeasured; the H2 gate passes with predictive probability 0.42 to 0.57; P(NEGATIVE | no excess) is 0.60 to 0.71 at seed SD 1 and the unconditional chance of a verdict about 0.1 to 0.25 (E19).
remediation: Bundle facts with the registered stop lists and the decision-62 simulation with the v3 code before any freeze; Kevin's rulings on decision 64 and admission; optionally the owner-approved CPU read of lane-862 chunk files.
